author: ThioJoe
description:
The default settings on iPhones are NOT good, here's what to change.

Right out of the box, there's a ton of settings in iOS (for iPhones) and similarly on iPadOS (for iPads) that are just plain annoying, or designed to benefit Apple instead of the user. But there's also a bunch of settings related to features that aren't enabled by default, but most people could still benefit from if you know about them. This video goes over several of these, whether to increase your battery life, enable cool features you didn't know about, fix random annoyances, or make your iPhone work better with cool features you can enable.
